lines.text: Venus. Surface pressure is ninety-two times Earth, and the ground sits near 465 degrees. Hotter than Mercury, even though it is farther from the sun.
The pressure in your suit only climbs. Cooling canisters slow it down, and you have ninety seconds. Three fragments, then get to the escape point.
Forty-five seconds left. Pressure is rising faster now - grab a canister on the way.
Hull Plating recovered. That is the last part - assemble the ship and let's go home.
Canisters are your lifeline. Never pass one without topping up.
Acid pools eat through the suit. Go around, never through.
The glowing fragments are the plating. The exit is marked with a beacon.
